chunks: And in the narration of Ibn Abī ʿUmayr from Ibn Udhaynah:
“The child is taken out, and her abdomen is sewn.”

key_terms.ٱبْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ: Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, the narrator transmitting this report
key_terms.ٱبْنِ أُذَيْنَةَ: Ibn Udhaynah, from whom the report is narrated

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about a deceased pregnant woman and the child in her womb?
ai.summary: This narration gives a legal ruling concerning a deceased pregnant woman. It states that the child is to be removed and her abdomen then sewn, indicating a practical funerary procedure in this circumstance.
